{{Top|leg}}
A '''Type I enviro-filter''' was a model of [[enviro filter]] that allowed the wearer to breathe in a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. While it was possible to adapt [[Ubese raider armor]] to accept a Type I enviro-filter, the modifications reduced the reliability of the seal.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
